PARAMS = {
    "gmid1":  (20.0, 12.0, 24.0),     # input CS device gm/Id
    "L1":     (0.5, 0.25, 1.0),
    "I1":     (12e-6, 8e-6, 15e-6),   # CS branch current
    "Isf":    (7e-6, 4e-6, 9e-6),     # source-follower current
    "gmid_sf":(18.0, 10.0, 22.0),
    "Rf":     (420e3, 370e3, 520e3),
    "Cf":     (2e-15, 0.2e-15, 8e-15),
    "Ipb":    (1.5e-6, 1e-6, 3e-6),   # pmos bias generation branch
    "gmid_p": (9.0, 6.0, 12.0),       # pmos load gm/Id
    "Lp":     (1.0, 0.5, 2.0),
}

def design(p, lut, spec):
    cpd = spec.get("cpd", 5e-13); cl = spec.get("cl", 2e-13)
    iref = spec.get("iref", 10e-6)
    I1, Isf, Ipb = p["I1"], p["Isf"], p["Ipb"]
    Lb = 1.0; gmid_b = 12.0

    # --- core devices ---
    m1 = lut.size("n", p["gmid1"], p["L1"], I1, vds=1.0)                 # CS input
    mp1 = lut.size("p", p["gmid_p"], p["Lp"], I1, vds=0.7)               # load
    vout_est = m1.vgs
    msf = lut.size("n", p["gmid_sf"], 0.5, Isf, vds=1.8 - vout_est - 0.1, vsb=vout_est)
    # --- bias chain ---
    mb0 = lut.size("n", gmid_b, Lb, iref, vds=0.6)                       # ibias diode
    mvg = mb0.vgs
    mb1 = lut.size("n", gmid_b, Lb, Isf, vds=vout_est)                   # SF sink
    mb2 = lut.size("n", gmid_b, Lb, Ipb, vds=1.0)                        # pbias sink
    mp0 = lut.size("p", p["gmid_p"], p["Lp"], Ipb, vds=0.9)              # pfet diode

    n = Netlist("iin vout vdd vss ibias")
    n.dev("MB0", "ibias", "ibias", "vss", "vss", mb0)
    n.dev("MB1", "vout", "ibias", "vss", "vss", mb1)
    n.dev("MB2", "pb", "ibias", "vss", "vss", mb2)
    n.dev("MP0", "pb", "pb", "vdd", "vdd", mp0)
    n.dev("MP1", "x", "pb", "vdd", "vdd", mp1)
    n.dev("M1", "x", "iin", "vss", "vss", m1)
    n.dev("MSF", "vdd", "x", "vout", "vss", msf)
    n.R("RF", "vout", "iin", p["Rf"])
    n.C("CF", "vout", "iin", p["Cf"])

    # --- predictions ---
    asf = msf.gm / (msf.gm + msf.gmbs + msf.gds + mb1.gds)
    gox = m1.gds + mp1.gds
    a0 = m1.gm / gox * asf
    zt = p["Rf"] * a0 / (1 + a0)
    cgs_sf = max(msf.cgg - msf.cgd, 0.0)
    cx = m1.cdd + mp1.cdd + msf.cgd + cgs_sf * (1 - asf) + 2e-15
    cin = cpd + m1.cgg + p["Cf"]
    tau = p["Rf"] * cin
    wa = gox / cx
    gbw = m1.gm * asf / cx
    wn = math.sqrt((1 + a0) * wa / tau)
    zeta = (wa + 1 / tau) / (2 * wn)
    k = 1 - 2 * zeta**2
    r = math.sqrt(k + math.sqrt(k * k + 1))
    wsf = (msf.gm + msf.gmbs) / (cl + mb1.cdd)
    w3 = wn * r / math.sqrt(1 + (wn * r / wsf) ** 2)     # crude SF-pole derating
    f3 = w3 / (2 * PI)

    kT = 1.380649e-23 * 300.15
    vn2 = 8 * kT / (3 * m1.gm) + 8 * kT / 3 * mp1.gm / m1.gm**2
    in2 = 4 * kT / p["Rf"] + vn2 * (2 * PI * 1e6 * cin) ** 2
    power = 1.8 * (iref + Ipb + I1 + Isf)

    return n, {"zt_dbohm": db(zt), "f3db": f3, "in_noise_1m": math.sqrt(in2),
               "power": power, "vout_dc": vout_est}
